Why one bad game doesn't have to define you.

Kevin explains how he struck out in little league, failed a math test and was held back a grade. Most of us carry moments like these for years.

Then he points to Michael Jordan, who missed the game-winning shot again and again. Jordan says that is exactly why he succeeded: he moved on from every miss.

The losses are the same for everyone. What matters is which ones you keep replaying.

Which old failure do you still replay in your head?
